name: finance-database
description: Give AI assistants a categorised map of 300,000+ financial symbols: equities, ETFs, funds, indices, currencies, cryptocurrencies and money markets.
long_description:
The Finance Database gives AI assistants access to 300,000+ symbols categorised by sector, industry group, industry, country, exchange, market cap tier, ETF and fund category, fund family and more. Find every mid cap semiconductor company in Taiwan, every bond ETF from a given issuer, or the ticker behind a company name or ISIN, and pass the results to the Finance Toolkit for fundamentals and prices.

No API key is needed: the database is free and open. It is downloaded once, cached locally and checked for updates at most once a day.

tools.name: equities
tools.description: Find stocks by country, sector, industry, exchange, market cap tier or name.

tools.name: etfs
tools.description: Find ETFs by category, issuer family, currency, exchange or name.

tools.name: funds
tools.description: Find mutual funds by category, fund family, currency, exchange or name.

tools.name: indices
tools.description: Find market indices by category, currency, exchange or name.

tools.name: currencies
tools.description: Find currency pairs by base and quote currency.

tools.name: cryptos
tools.description: Find cryptocurrency pairs by coin and quote currency.

tools.name: moneymarkets
tools.description: Find money market funds by currency, fund family or name.

tools.name: search_categories
tools.description: List the asset classes with their tool, number of entries, filterable fields and description.

tools.name: show_options
tools.description: Show the valid values of a filter (e.g. every sector or country) for an asset class, optionally narrowed by other filters.

tools.name: search_instruments
tools.description: Find instruments by ticker, name or ISIN across all asset classes at once.
